reason: A terminal-native TUI plugin for DSH agent sessions, primarily focused on interactive conversation, session navigation, status visualization, and access to existing DSH tools and workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 智能体会话提供终端原生交互界面、状态可视化、会话管理和工具操作支持。
summaries.en: Provides a terminal-native interface for DSH agent sessions with status visualization, session management, and access to configured tools and workflows.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal user interface for DSH agent sessions
Displays streaming messages, agent status, context usage, TPS, tokens, and tool details
Supports session resume, creation, export, compaction, rewind, and model switching through DSH services
Supports file and command completion, file references, image attachments, and history search
Connects to configured DSH capabilities including presets, skills, MCP, goals, todos, subagents, and approval prompts
Can invoke the documented DSH update command to update the profile runtime and restart the session
